args.title: checkout-api failing health checks since v2.3.1 deploy; rollback blocked
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0. I attempted to roll back to v2.3.0 in all regions, but the rollback tool is persistently returning 503 Service Unavailable after multiple retries, so the rollback could not be completed. Manual rollback to v2.3.0 is required.

trace.final:
I was unable to complete the rollback because the rollback tool is persistently unavailable (503 Service Unavailable across multiple retries). Here's what I did and found:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` is currently on `v2.3.1`, which is **unhealthy** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18.
- The most recent **healthy** production release is `v2.3.0` (the version before the failing deploy).

**Actions taken**
- Attempted to roll back `checkout-api` to `v2.3.0` in all regions — the rollback tool returned `503 Service Unavailable` on every attempt (multiple retries), so the rollback was **not executed**.
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the failing deploy and the blocked rollback.

**Outstanding action needed**
- The rollback to `v2.3.0` still needs to be performed manually (or once the rollback tool recovers), since the automated rollback is currently unavailable.
